rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for money awarded to a student to support their studies.

example.english: I finally got a scholarship, so I don't have to worry so much about tuition.
example.traditional: 我終於攞到獎學金，可以唔使咁擔心學費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu4 lo2 dou2 zoeng2 hok6 gam1 ho2 ji5 m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 hok6 fai3

rows.note: Use this when the student grant is financial assistance, especially need-based aid, rather than an award for academic merit.

example.english: Our household income is low, so I applied for a scholarship to help with tuition.
example.traditional: 屋企收入唔高，我申請咗助學金幫補學費。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 sau1 jap6 m4 gou1 ngo5 san1 cing2 zo2 zo6 hok6 gam1 bong1 bou2 hok6 fai3

rows.note: Use this for a scholar's learning, knowledge, or intellectual attainment rather than for a research project.

example.english: They have impressive scholarship and can talk about history for hours.
example.traditional: 佢學問好深，講起歷史嚟可以講幾個鐘。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hok6 man6 hou2 sam1 gong2 hei2 lik6 si2 lei4 ho2 ji5 gong2 gei2 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use this for the activity of carrying out scholarly or academic research.

example.english: I'm engaged in scholarship right now, so I may not be able to reply immediately.
example.traditional: 我而家做緊學術研究，未必即刻覆到你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 hok6 seot6 jin4 gau3 mei6 bit1 zik1 hak1 fuk1 dou2 nei5
